items.item: The orders table starts in the first viewport; no KPI cards, hero or greeting above it
items.evidence: Table is visible in the first viewport (firstTableTop 386), but a four-card KPI strip (section#kpis: 'Doanh số tháng 11', 'Chờ xác nhận', 'Đang xử lý / giao', 'Công nợ chưa thu') sits above it.

items.item: Page header has a plural title and exactly one primary action (create order)
items.evidence: h1 'Đơn hàng bán' (Vietnamese has no plural marker; it is the list title). One filled primary button '+ Tạo đơn hàng' (#btnNew); 'Xuất Excel' is a secondary outline button. Audit headerPrimaryActions: 1.

items.item: 2–3 filters are visible; applied filters show as removable chips with a clear-all control
items.evidence: Five filters plus search are visible at once (Kênh bán, Thanh toán, Nhân viên KD, Từ ngày, Đến ngày). No applied-filter chips are rendered. Only a 'Xóa bộ lọc' (#btnReset) button exists, with no per-filter removal.

items.item: Status tabs or saved views show counts
items.evidence: renderTabs() builds role=tab buttons with count pills: 'Tất cả 137', 'Nháp 16', 'Chờ xác nhận 26', and so on.

items.item: Bulk selection has a header checkbox with an indeterminate state and a bulk bar showing the selected count
items.evidence: #chkAll sets .indeterminate = n>0 && n<ids.length. #bulkBar shows '<span id=selCount> đơn được chọn' plus the total value.

items.item: When results span pages, the user can select all matching results, not just the visible page
items.evidence: #chkAll is labelled 'Chọn tất cả đơn trên trang này' and only selects the current page's ids (dataset.ids). There is no 'select all N matching' affordance even though 137 orders span 7 pages.

items.item: Amounts are right-aligned with tabular figures and locale currency formatting; dates are absolute
items.evidence: Total cell has 'text-right num' (tabular-nums). fmtVND uses toLocaleString('vi-VN') + ' ₫' (e.g. 25.272.000 ₫). Dates are absolute via fmtDate ('4/11/2026 16:41'). Audit numericCells misaligned 0, nonTabular 0.

items.item: Filtering to zero results shows a no-results state with a way to clear filters, distinct from the first-use empty state
items.evidence: #empty shows 'Không có đơn hàng phù hợp' with a 'Xóa bộ lọc' button (#btnReset2), so the no-results state exists. There is no separate first-use empty state (no-orders-yet with a create CTA), so the two are not distinguished.

items.item: Row actions show at most two visible controls; icon-only controls have accessible names
items.evidence: Each row has one visible .rowact button (e.g. 'Giao vận chuyển') plus the order-code link. There are no icon-only row controls. Audit icon-button-name has no violation. Pager arrows have aria-labels.

items.item: A destructive bulk action (cancel orders) asks for confirmation naming the count and the consequence
items.evidence: bulkRun('cancel') calls confirmDlg with title 'Hủy N đơn hàng?'. The description reads 'N đơn sẽ được chuyển sang "Đã hủy"... Thao tác này không thể hoàn tác hàng loạt.' It uses a red danger button and an alertdialog role.

notes: Audit score 72: target-size (16px row checkboxes, 20px-high code links), sidebar section-label contrast 3.75:1, two-line customer cells in 20 of 20 rows, and a shadow-sm on the table card. Rainbow-status: seven distinct status hues (slate, amber, blue, indigo, cyan, emerald, red). Uppercase tracking appears on table headers and sidebar group labels. Dark slate-900 sidebar with a blue-600 accent. The KPI strip is plain text cards with no icons or deltas, so it is not flagged as kpi-icon-tiles; it still fails checklist item 1. The row-action column is clipped at the right edge at 1440px (screenshot shows a cut-off 'Giao…' button). The Vietnamese 'Chờ xác nhận' tab count is computed ignoring the active tab but respecting the other filters, which is fine. No gradient, glass, emoji, greeting, hover-lift or oversized radius (max 8px).
